verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, mechanics, and known cost while preserving unresolved acquisition fields as null.
research_scope: Meteor Blow — Strike Super mechanics and acquisition-status research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository exact-name coverage and seeded Strike Super membership with current Xenoverse 2 documentation and independent Dragon Ball technique documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Meteor Blow was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Meteor Blow as a common rush-oriented Super Skill used by the Future Warrior and multiple cast characters; the repository's seeded category places it under Strike Supers.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The reviewed sources establish Meteor Blow as an obtainable Future Warrior Super Skill but do not provide sufficiently reliable current Xenoverse 2 acquisition-route evidence for a specific shop, mentor lesson, or Parallel Quest. The canonical unlock fields therefore remain null rather than importing an unsupported historical route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because no reliable current acquisition route or Ultimate Finish condition was established.
verification_audit.cost_policy: Ki and stamina costs remain null because the reviewed evidence did not establish reliable current canonical numeric values.

records.name: Meteor Blow
records.skill_description: A rush attack in which the user kicks the opponent upward with both feet, then teleports behind the airborne target and kicks them away.
records.mechanics_notes: Independent Xenoverse 2 documentation describes a two-stage rush: a launching double-foot kick followed by a teleporting second kick. Community documentation notes that the follow-up can be extended with additional input, but exact current input/cost behavior is version-sensitive and is not promoted to canonical numeric data here.
records.acquisition_notes: Meteor Blow is documented as a common Super Skill usable by the Future Warrior and appears on multiple character presets. No sufficiently reliable current source was found establishing one canonical CaC unlock route, so acquisition remains unresolved.
records.pve_notes: Acquisition route unresolved; do not infer a Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement.
records.pvp_notes: Rush-oriented Strike Super with a teleporting follow-up kick. Exact frame, hitbox, and extension behavior remains version-sensitive.
